notes.title: 2021 Update
notes.content:
-Fixed bug that prevented players from getting the "Evil Overlord" achievement
-Added wildlife to some of the levels

notes.title: Big Head Mode
notes.content:
I am proud to announce that the entirety of [b][i]Gunslingers of the Wasteland vs. the Zombies From Mars[/i][/b] can be played through in Big Head Mode: 

[previewyoutube=tNKeYPPXI_w;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

This option does not require unlocking and is available by default from the main menu.
